run.command: strata bench run --profile <profile> --suite standard-v1 --track custom --quantization IQ3_XXS --custom-pack IQ3_XXS GGUF quantized with ISTA-DASLab GSQ-RCO (2 shards, 71GB); repacked with tools/iq_pack.py schema 1 into a schema-1 pack directory; plus repo expert-profile.bin (24576-expert ordering) and MTP drafter (Q2_0 GGUF, t=4) --build-options Release,STRATA_PORTABLE=ON,CUDA12.6,arch=sm_87-real+virtual,ggml=vendored-strata-ggml-0.24.0,STRATA_MMQ_KQUANTS=ON,STRATA_MMQ_TQ_OVERLAY=ON,STRATA_NATIVE_EXPERTS=ON,STRATA_Q6K_EXPERTS=ON --track-notes Custom production profile on Jetson AGX Orin 64GB (nvgpu, CUDA 12.6, 12-core armv8.2-a+dotprod+fp16+i8mm): IQ3_XXS quant + custom pack + expert profile; prefill auto:16384, prompt-cache 4 + tail, conversation-cache 2048MiB (min-free 1024MiB), expert-cache 4000, kv int8, vram-reserve 4096MiB, pool-workers 3, MTP drafter t=4 min-p 0.5, ple-io mmap, max-context 131072; engine 0.1.59.1 built from upstream main 13eedf55 with the vendored strata-ggml --background none --optional-concurrency --output human

model.custom_pack: IQ3_XXS GGUF quantized with ISTA-DASLab GSQ-RCO (2 shards, 71GB); repacked with tools/iq_pack.py schema 1 into a schema-1 pack directory; plus repo expert-profile.bin (24576-expert ordering) and MTP drafter (Q2_0 GGUF, t=4)

configuration.track_notes: Custom production profile on Jetson AGX Orin 64GB (nvgpu, CUDA 12.6, 12-core armv8.2-a+dotprod+fp16+i8mm): IQ3_XXS quant + custom pack + expert profile; prefill auto:16384, prompt-cache 4 + tail, conversation-cache 2048MiB (min-free 1024MiB), expert-cache 4000, kv int8, vram-reserve 4096MiB, pool-workers 3, MTP drafter t=4 min-p 0.5, ple-io mmap, max-context 131072; engine 0.1.59.1 built from upstream main 13eedf55 with the vendored strata-ggml
